title: Duplicatus of the Deep
story: The evil sea monster Duplicatus rises from the waves to smash the fishing fleet! But this beast has a strange curse: every time Mr 6 strikes him, Duplicatus doubles in size. Right now the monster is 8 feet tall, and Mr 6's sword arm is itching.
question: If Mr 6 strikes Duplicatus 3 times, how tall will the monster be, in feet?
hint: Double 8 once for each strike: 8 becomes 16, then 16 becomes... keep doubling, 3 times in all.
victory: 64 feet tall — too big to fight, but Mr 6 knew that all along! Now enormous and clumsy, Duplicatus can't catch the nimble fishing boats, and he wobbles back into the deep, defeated by his own curse.
